description: Renovate proposes dependency updates as pull requests, once a week; nothing is merged by itself.

The ecosystems Dependabot covered: Cargo (MyOrbiter's workspace at the root, TennoScope's in tennoscope/), npm (MyOrbiter's window at the root, TennoScope's app in tennoscope/app, pnpm), and GitHub Actions (the workflow's actions, pinned by commit, with the version in a comment; Renovate keeps both). The builder image GitLab's pipeline used (ci/Dockerfile) isn't part of the GitHub workflow, which runs ci/build.sh on ubuntu-22.04.
With osvVulnerabilityAlerts, a dependency with a known vulnerability (OSV) gets its own pull request, in place of Dependabot's security updates.
Minor and patch updates come grouped, one pull request per ecosystem and folder; a major version comes on its own, since it may need code changes.
TypeScript 7 waits for MyOrbiter (the root) until svelte-check supports it; TennoScope is on it already.
